name: s04-s05-m2
title: s04 bunker + s05 whiteboard m2 (v8 x12 pictures): workshop cue, music treatment per conspiracy m4c (+9, word-speed ducking, high cut)
notes: Audio-only remix of m1 (s04 35485aa, s05 04e9a8c). The music PLAN is m1's, unchanged: one render of the workshop cue on the film timeline (s04 then s05), split at sample 2,232,000 (s04 46.5 s); segments A-F with m1's bars, anchors (bar 13 on the RENT stamp f879, bar 25 downbeat end on the freeze f1484, bar 27 final chord on the shrug f2210), chains, 20 ms equal-power splice edges ending 5 ms before each attack, the 0.372 s stop-time break and the 0.5 s tail. Downbeats are m1's measured attacks, found again on m1's detection signal (mono, +2.9 dB, 180 Hz high-pass) and checked against m1's report. No cue moved: the cue enters at s04 1.583 s on the sheet's unroll (bar 1 is the file's first bar; any whole-bar pull to frame 0 would take bar 7 off the curve's last stroke and move the chain into s05), and s05 continues it from the first sample.

Treatment (conspiracy m4c, 70fecfa): cue folded to mono, 100 Hz high-pass, high shelf 6 kHz -6 dB and 11 kHz -8 dB, normalised to -18 LUFS integrated before placement; intro (bars 1-6, 0.8-3.6 dB under the body by 3 s short-term median) levelled toward the body median, max 6 dB, ramping out over bar 6 (applied in track time, so the thin intro bars spliced into s05 are levelled too). Under speech -11.3 dB re the normalised cue (cue loudness -29.3 LUFS), +5 dB between words; sidechain from the delivered dialogue across both scenes (key 10 ms RMS, -44..-38 dBFS, 30 ms look-ahead attack, 300 ms release). m1's gap rises (-14), RENT swell (-10), dip across the cut (-24), stop and final-chord steps (-16/-12) and the 16 dB guard trim are gone.
Spectral check (65536-point Welch, prominence over a 1 kHz running median): highest peak above 12 kHz 6.2 dB (17.8 kHz), no isolated tone (the 2-12 kHz band peaks at 5.5 dB): no notch.

Sound effects as m1 (film/sfx out/work files, m1's -20 LUFS event-loudness gains from m1's report, hits on the same frames), except the stamp: SUPER stamped (stamp-thump-2) -6 -> -8 dB. The RENT cash register (s05 f879) is not a stamp sound and keeps 0 dB.
Program per scene: finish-m3.py (-16 LUFS, true peak <= -1.3 dBTP, limiter latency-compensated; m1 used alimiter 0.95 and reached up to +0.2 dBTP).
